field_evidence: Official MHCLG Planning Data authoritative listed-building-outline entity 42169022 from Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council publishes a closed, nonzero-area MultiPolygon of Plaza Cinema, Mersey Square, Stockport, with direct listed-building reference 1257697, entry date 1997-03-12 and no end date. Historic England statutory NHLE 1257697 independently confirms the same Plaza Cinema, Grade II*, first listed 12 March 1997, designed in 1929 and constructed 1932-33 by W Thornley, as a purpose-built Art Deco super cinema with an auditorium and Compton organ. NHLE also records use as a bingo hall when surveyed. BUILDING_PRESENT and historical type Cinema are directly evidenced, but current cinema operation is not asserted. This official source footprint is not a canonical cadastral parcel; local spatial join and materialization remain pending.
